title: Seagrove Peace of Mind Santa Rosa Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewIf you’re looking for an easy, no-stress 30A stay—this is it. Located in a gated private community, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home puts you just a quick 600-step walk (about 0.3 miles) to the beach at Beachwood Villas access. No packing up the car, no fighting for parking—just grab your stuff and go.You’re also less than 1.5 miles from Seaside, so you can bike or cruise over in minutes for restaurants, shopping, and all the 30A energy.Inside, the home offers 1,832 sq ft of comfortable space with a layout that works great for families or groups. Out back, you’ve got a peaceful pond view—perfect for morning coffee or winding down after a beach day. Fire up the propane grill, let the kids hang out, and actually relax.This spot hits that sweet spot—close to everything, but still quiet enough to actually enjoy your time. Whether you’re here for beach days, bike rides, or just hanging out, it’s set up to make your trip easy.HOME HIGHLIGHTS: 600 steps (0.3 mile) to beach accessUnder 1.5 miles to SeasideGated, private communityBackyard pond viewsParking for 4 vehicles (huge bonus on 30A)Propane grill + Wi-Fi3 bikes included for easy exploringSLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: Primary Bedroom (1st Floor): King bed, private bath, twin sized bedGuest Bedroom (2nd Floor): King bed, shared hall bath (shower)Bunk Room (2nd Floor): Two twin-over-twin bunks, shared hall bath (shower)House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**AREA ATTRACTIONS: One of the original and most beloved communities along Scenic Highway 30A, Seagrove Beach vacation rentals offer a classic coastal experience rooted in natural beauty, walkability, and laid-back charm. Located just east of Seaside, Seagrove Beach is known for its easy beach access, coastal dune lakes, and relaxed Old-Florida vibe that appeals to families, couples, and repeat 30A visitors.Show less
